<thought>I'll retrieve polymorphs for a single additional oxide composition ("ZnO") using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the required filters. This will confirm the tool works for further calls, after which I can repeat for the remaining oxides and finally consolidate all files.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": ["ZnO"],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}
